steps.content: As night falls, the banks of the Rust are instantly plunged into darkness.
The piles of trash mixed together with the polluted river give off an eye-watering stench.
From dark corners, a few unnamable creatures oozing a black, foul-smelling pus-like liquid watch the nearby human motionlessly.
A few low growls come from behind you, and before you can react, the Corruptor is shot and falls to the ground.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Target eliminated. You should be more careful, Chief... you have a mission to complete.
Thanks, I will.
A few hours earlier...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Emergency mission order from the FAC.
Nightingale transfers a vigilantly sealed document over to you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Your orders are to go straight to the Rust and use Wendy as a decoy to investigate the source of the Corruptor weapon materials.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: As well as to get to the bottom of the former secret cleanup unit.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The connection to this previously presumed dead former cleanup unit has been confirmed. the higher-ups are taking this matter very seriously.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This is our only chance to get in close contact with the organization dealing in Corruptor remains!
I know what to do.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Support will be stationed 5 kilometers from your position and will await your orders. Snipers, however, will be on standby.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: They can be activated whenever the need arises.
As you contemplate how to carry out the mission, the roar of a chainsaw grates against your ears as the Corruptor that was just shot is pinned to the garbage pile and instantly severed in two.
...Wendy.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Oh... Did I scare you? Hahaha... that’s the Rust for ya, Chiefy!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: There are monsters everywhere! They’re monsters and I’m a monster! And you are, too! Hahaha!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: If you’re scared... then you’d better head back to your shelter while you still can!
It wasn't anything serious, of course, but thanks for your help.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hehe.
The creatures hiding in the corner seem to fear Wendy. Not daring to rush forward again, they whimper reluctantly from where they are.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hee hee... that’s the Rust for you...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: To survive, you have to try as hard as you can to become a monster yourself...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: The cans in the garbage heaps, the maggots born on the rotting meat—all fuel for survival!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hehehe... If that doesn't work, those monsters' bodies could pull you through for a day or two.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Let’s go, Chief. You won’t get a full view of the Rust sitting behind a high wall with those flying little bugs.
Wendy once again chucks the chainsaw behind her. It falls into a corner of a nearby reconnaissance aircraft with a crash that makes the monsters yelp and babble.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hee hee hee hee hee... How I’ve waited to hear those screams!
Wendy seems rather excited now, perhaps because she's returned to a familiar place.
You were always saying that you wanted to come back and see the Rust.
Given how cooperative you've been in our talks, I submitted a request to the higher-ups to let you come with me.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Go with you? This many people?
...It's just you and me.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Heh...
Wendy scoffs, yanks at your hand suddenly as her pace quickens, then slips into some ruins.
Wendy?!
Your chest tightens—Most of the ruins around here are the remains of the Black Ring explosions, which also threw the magnetic fields into chaos.

You hear some electric hums from the communication device concealed behind your ear before it stops working completely. You have no way to call for support and your positioning system has been disrupted.
Fortunately, Wendy comes to a stop before long and looks steadily forward. Seeing that you've caught up, she pulls you to her side and points ahead.
What's that?!
Under the moonlight, you can make out several figures in black cloaks. They're digging for something.
How... could there still be people wandering the Rust at a time like this?!
Moments later, a distinctive smell mixed with the damp stench of the Rust wafts over and sends chills down your spine.
These people... They're digging up buried bodies!!
Were you pointing at these people? Are they your companions?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: No.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: They’re devils...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: They held back in the darkness for so long... then waited until I was gone... to dig up the bodies...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: But what they don’t know... is that I would disappear, then reappear again... Hahahaha...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I think this is... the mission the Rust gave to me.
Mission? You mean you're going to carve those dead corruptors or...?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: They aren't good people at all, so it's okay to kill them, right? It's okay to kill them!
It took such a long to pick up their trail, and now you're worried that Wendy's actions would frighten them off. You gently grab her hand and keep her by your side.
Not so fast, Wendy.

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer B
steps.content: *Cough cough* Ugh, it smells like **** around here...

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Keep your ****ing voice down.

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Just because the Reaper’s been gone for a while doesn’t mean we can suddenly let our guard down!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: We’ve finished digging here. I hear they found a few more pits of this stuff to the south.

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Let’s go and dig ‘em all up! Then that’ll be a wrap on this month’s quota!
Buried somewhere else... Even if these smugglers aren't from this transport chain, what they're doing now is grounds enough for an arrest.
Wendy, you...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: South? How dare you... defile my home...!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: No! I won’t let you get away with it!
You realize that Wendy has already wrenched herself free from your hand and is staring daggers at the group.
Her tightly clenched teeth grind together, making an unnerving sound. Wendy grips the chainsaw, looking like she'll charge forward at any moment.
Easy there, Wendy. If you're trying to tip them off to help them escape, I must say, this is...
Before you can finish your sentence, Wendy has bolted.
Contrary to your expectations, Wendy is not helping those people escape—she's raising her chainsaw.

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer B
steps.content: Hey! Someone’s rushing this way!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Who’re you?! Here to steal the bodies?!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: That’s not it!! That sound and... that weapon...

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: It’s "the Reaper of the Rust"!!!!
You rush to catch up with Wendy, who fortunately hasn't crossed the line just yet.
She hasn't let them go, but she hasn't killed them all yet either. Instead, she's giving two of them a serious thrashing and stamping on their wrists to stop them from doing anything.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hee hee hee... The Rust’s little mice...
Now forcefully restrained by Wendy, the two hurl curses at her one minute then bitterly beg for mercy the next.
As you prepare to check their identities, you discover something strange.
Wait a minute... What's that on your necks?!
The FAC has always believed that the ones behind the Rust body trade were leftover dissidents from the Catastrophe Cleanup Squad.
But the body brokers you see before you aren't anything like you imagined.
The symbols on their necks mean that they're from Black Water, and their faces don't match any of the rebels in the database.
It's always the last person you want to see that you end up running into, huh?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Chief, how about you just let me kill them? They're all garbage and scumbags, they deserve to die...

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Ch-Chief?! Wait a minute, you’re the chief of the Bureau?!
That's me. Have you decided to surrender?

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Ah! You really are with the FAC! Th-That’s great!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: L-Let’s talk this over!

options: What do you want to talk about?

choices.text: What do you want to talk about?

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Hehe, there’s nothing to be nervous about! Let’s work out a deal!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Let’s work together—You never saw me, and you’ll tell your superiors that you didn’t discover anything unusual.

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: And when we finish up our... business... we’ll give you a cut! Whaddya say?
The two gravediggers kneel on the ground and smile obsequiously.

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: And don’t you worry, this wouldn’t be the first time there’s been a deal like this! Not by a long shot!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Our old boss had one with your, uh, whatchamacallit cleaning squad. Heck, we all just called them the Undertakers! They had a good few deals! Now that was a captain that really got it!
The Undertakers? The Undertakers were the secret contamination cleanup squad?
Hearing that familiar word, you can't help but look over at Wendy. She's turned stiff as a board listening to the body broker's story.

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Yeah, that’s it! The something contamination cleanup squad, they were one of the FAC’s! They got it!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Your top brass would make ‘em do all this dangerous stuff without even sending them good gear.

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Heh, they’d make the contaminated ones clean up the Corruptors bare-handed, basically making Corruptor production bases!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Ha! What’s so impossible about it? Those were their underlings, after all!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Isn’t that what they think at the top? What are the lives of a few underlings? They’ll all have to die in the end anyway!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Don’t believe me if you don’t want to, but have a good think about this deal!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Just like that Undertaker captain!!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: I’ll be blunt—they sent you all the way here for an investigation because they were hoping you’d get yourself killed! Isn’t that right, Chief?
The body brokers chatter on, looking like flies struggling in the mud.
You also notice that Wendy hasn't made a sound in a while... Especially since she heard them talking about the Undertakers.
Wendy, go ahead and tie these guys up... What are you doing?!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hahaha... Undertakers? I’m an Undertaker!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Fancy that, it was you guys all along...

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: You're an Undertaker?! I heard they were all executed, I didn't think there were any left alive!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Ahahaha, since you’re one of them, then you must get how badly those guys at the top treated you!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Just do what your captain did...
Wendy charges forward, steps on the body broker's head with one foot, and plunges her rapidly whirling chainsaw into the ground next to his head, kicking up dirt and debris.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: You seem to remember our captain... very well.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Yes... We were the Undertakers!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: In this filthy world, someone had to step up to the plate and face the contamination head-on.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: We carried a heavy responsibility... to clear a bright path for everyone else!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: But those traitors! They sold us all out!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Th-That’s perfectly normal!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Think of the job you had, and you had no protection or even bonuses for doing it!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Your top brass treated you like tattered rags! They used you and threw you away!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: What your captain did is completely understandable!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Completely understandable?

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Yes! Think about it, you didn’t even have any decent protective equipment!

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: I remember there was also a young kid in your squad back then. Your captain brought it up.

steps.speaker: Corpse Dealer A
steps.content: Tsk, tsk, so young, but right at the front and wrapped up in a few pieces of scrap metal.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Yes... yes... the child!!!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: He got completely infected during the mission... and turned crazy just like me!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I wanted to save him... but the captain kept telling me he was dead!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: In the end, I was left with just his clothes and toys...
Wendy lifted the body broker by the collar, forcing him to look into her eyes.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I buried one, two, three... people.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: So many people left me, and now they're stuck rotting in filthy piles of garbage!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I won’t accept his end or theirs!! I can’t!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Damn him, he... He betrayed everything we believed in!! I'll kill them, kill them all, those... traitors!!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: You... You dirtbags, you’re just more trash in this stream of filth, you can’t even be called human!
Raising her chainsaw, Wendy hits the switch to unleash her powers. She looks like she wants to tear the people before her into pieces.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Your hands... Your feet... You won't be wanting those, will you!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hahaha... Look... Look at this filthy cake, it took a tumble into the mud! It’s trash now! Lemme just cut it all up!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Captains, Corruptors, people that sell corpses—they're all just nasty garbage!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I’m an Undertaker... a cleanser!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: I can’t let the contamination... overflow to the world!
Chief
Stop!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Get out of here!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: You wanna make a deal? With them?!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: So, you’re gonna betray me, too?!
You can hear the rage and hurt in Wendy's voice, and its power has grown extraordinarily.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the Sinister Singularity’s mood is extremely unstable! A sniper must be activated immediately...
You don't want to resort to snipers or use your abilities.
Wendy, I believe you, I believe that everything you just said is the truth!
The chainsaw presses against your shoulder, rending its skin and flesh. The pain is so excruciating you're unable to finish speaking.
Hnnggg...!
Wendy, listen to me! You can't make yourself guilty of killing these two people!
I... I want to become your companion, I want... No, I can be someone you can depend on now and after all this! Please... believe me!
Wendy's roar stops and she stares at you with vacant, bloodshot eyes, not moving a muscle.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Why...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Why do you want to be my companion...? You’ll only turn crazy like me! Or into a corpse!

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Yo would really... do that...?
The chainsaw whines horribly as it swings down and carves in.
A warm, sticky liquid sprays onto each of your faces.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Cleanup, cleanup complete.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Filth.
The chain of clues was broken due to Wendy's impulsive killing.
The FAC confirmed that Wendy and the Undertakers were collaborating with Black Water, and that they were done away with to cover up the Undertakers' defection and smuggling of Mania weapons.
Wendy will face serious punishment in the future, and the Undertakers... a settlement order was passed down—Not even their bodies would be allowed to go free.
